goal: A 4:3 or 1:1 composite image featuring 9 independent Q-style stickers, with the main character being a fictional gold-brown curly-haired female singer (signature elements: gold-brown long curls, red lips, acoustic guitar), aiming for a cute cartoon style rather than photographic realism.
theme: Concert and fan roadshow memes, friendship wristbands, vinyl and microphones

style.rendering: Flat + slight cel shading + soft shadows, clean color blocks.
style.color_palette: Golden brown hair + bright red + ink black + creamy white, accented with mint green and lavender purple.

sticker_design.shadow: None or very light, avoid excessive 3D thickness.
sticker_design.label_style: Short Chinese handwritten words below, 2-4 characters, deep brown

items: Q Version Female Singer Holding a Wooden Guitar, Singing + 'Start Singing'
Cat ear headband holding a kitten + 'cat slave'
Holding an umbrella in a heavy rain + 'Rain Performance'
Colorful paper wristband on the wrist + 'Change wristband'
Heart-shaped hand gesture towards the camera + 'Sending hearts'
Handing the microphone to the audience + 'Grand Chorus'

constraints.must_keep: The nine frames must have the same line width and color palette; each image can be used for individual circular cropping.
constraints.avoid: Write the full name of a real public figure in a prominent position on the image, recognizable trademark album cover 1:1 replica
